verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud documents a hardened Chromium fork with stealth on by default and residential proxies enabled by default across 195+ countries, which covers the stealth-fingerprinting and residential-proxy parts of the story. The evidence describes all of this only as cloud-browser defaults, and only vendor docs support it. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented country/geo-selection parameter or fingerprint configuration controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the stealth/proxy setup avoids bot blocking.
